categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to avoid throwing in destructors on write failure.
categories.rationale: Prevents `std::terminate` crashes on disk write errors by handling buffered stream write failures outside the destructor. When disk writes fail (such as on a full filesystem), `AutoFile::write_buffer()` throws, and relying on `BufferedWriter`'s destructor triggered uncatchable termination without clean diagnostic logs.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` (+2/-1) are mechanical callsite updates following the `BufferedWriter` API change.
categories.rationale: The two-line edit in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` merely adapts block and undo writers to call `flush()` explicitly as required by `BufferedWriter`, with no substantive changes to block storage logic.
